title: St. Teresa's Bookmark Prayer
text:
Let nothing disturb you.
Let nothing frighten you.
All things are passing away:
God never changes.
Patience obtains everything.
Whoever has God lacks nothing;
God alone suffices.

translation.spanish:
Nada te turbe,
nada te espante,
todo se pasa,
Dios no se muda,
la paciencia
todo lo alcanza;
quien a Dios tiene
nada le falta:
sólo Dios basta.
translation.latin:
Nihil te turbet,
nihil te terreat,
omnia transeunt:
Deus non mutatur.
Patientia
omnia obtinet;
qui Deum habet
nihil ei deest:
solus Deus sufficit.

notes: St. Teresa of Avila's famous bookmark prayer, found in her breviary after her death. This powerful prayer of abandonment to God's will has comforted countless souls through the centuries. St. Teresa was a Spanish Carmelite nun, mystic, and Doctor of the Church, renowned for her mystical experiences and reforms of the Carmelite order.
